Onboarding.title: Welcome to Mnemos
Onboarding.intro: Mnemos is a notes app with smart search and summaries. You stay in control of whether AI runs on your device or uses the cloud.

bullets.capture: Write and keep your notes in one place.
bullets.search: Search your notes by meaning (not just exact words).
bullets.summaries: Generate short summaries to catch up fast.

ai.title: How AI works
ai.onDevice: Some AI features can run locally, which usually means no internet is needed.
ai.cloud: If you enable it, Mnemos may send the text needed to create a summary or improve search to a cloud helper. This can be useful when your device is busy or doesn’t support a feature.
ai.settingsHint: You can change these choices anytime in Settings.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: Learn how Mnemos handles, stores, and protects your notes.

PrivacyPolicy.heroTitle: Your notes stay on your device
PrivacyPolicy.intro: Mnemos is built as a privacy-first notebook designed to run on your device. This page explains what data is created, where it lives, and the limited cases where it can leave your browser.

localDataPoints.title: Notes and deleted notes
localDataPoints.description: Your notes live entirely inside your browser using IndexedDB. No background sync or remote storage is performed. When you delete a note you can undo it, and it is kept hidden on your device for 7 days before being permanently removed.

localDataPoints.title: Chunks and embeddings
localDataPoints.description: Semantic-search chunks and the vectors generated for them are stored on your device. If you opt into remote embedding fallback, the chunk text needed for that request is sent to the server and the resulting vector returns to IndexedDB. A short log of on-device indexing errors is also kept locally.

localDataPoints.title: Preferences and caches
localDataPoints.description: Your settings, theme, whether you have seen the welcome screen, the downloaded AI models and the app files needed to work offline are kept in your browser storage. If your browser language differs from the app language you pick, a language-preference cookie may also be set.

aiDisclosures.title: Summaries: only when you press Summarize
aiDisclosures.description: Summaries are only generated when you ask for one. By default ("Allow fallback" in Settings) Mnemos summarizes on your device, but if the on-device model is not ready yet (for example it is still downloading), fails, or takes longer than 30 seconds, and you are online, the full text of that note is sent to Mnemos' server and on to Hugging Face's inference API. "Cloud only" always sends it. Choose "On your device only" to never send note text for summaries. Each summary tells you whether it was generated on your device or in the cloud. Mnemos does not store the text.

aiDisclosures.title: No hidden uploads
aiDisclosures.description: Mnemos never syncs your notes in the background. Text leaves your device only through the summary and embedding options described here.

aiDisclosures.title: Embedding fallback is opt-in
aiDisclosures.description: Embeddings are computed on your device, and this is the default ("On your device only"). If you turn on remote embedding fallback, then after on-device processing fails or times out the text of the affected note chunks (and, for semantic search, your search query) is sent to Mnemos' server and Hugging Face to generate vectors. When it is off, the app offers to enable it after a failure and nothing is sent until you agree.

aiDisclosures.title: Network visibility
aiDisclosures.description: Remote requests use HTTPS and can be inspected in your browser's network panel. Mnemos also downloads AI models from Hugging Face the first time they are needed; no note content is part of those downloads, but Hugging Face sees your IP address. Images you insert by URL are loaded by your browser directly from the address you entered.

userControls.title: Delete data at any time
userControls.description: Use your browser's storage controls to clear IndexedDB/localStorage or delete notes individually inside the app (they are permanently removed from your device 7 days later).

userControls.title: Operate fully offline
userControls.description: After the first visit and the one-time model downloads, Mnemos remains functional without connectivity, preventing accidental data transfer and letting you audit network usage yourself.

userControls.title: Auditability
userControls.description: The entire codebase is open-source, so you can verify the storage model or run your own build.

onDevice.title: Data stored on your device
onDevice.description: Everything below is stored directly on your device using IndexedDB/localStorage. Mnemos does not transmit this data except through the summary and embedding options described below.
onDevice.implementationDetail: Implementation detail: when fallback is used, Mnemos posts the affected chunk text and IDs to the server-side embed action in {path}, which forwards them to Hugging Face only long enough to generate vectors; the returned embeddings are stored back in IndexedDB. Summaries use a similar server action in src/server-actions/summarize.ts.

dataLeaves.title: When data leaves your device
dataLeaves.description: Mnemos contacts remote services only in these cases: you summarize a note and the summary setting is "Allow fallback" (the default) and the on-device model cannot do it, or "Cloud only"; you enable remote embedding fallback (chunk text and search queries are then sent for embedding); or the browser downloads AI models from Hugging Face. With both settings on "On your device only", no note content leaves your device.
dataLeaves.noAnalytics: Mnemos does not collect analytics, advertising identifiers, or tracking cookies. When you use the server options, the Mnemos server also sees your IP address, which it uses only for in-memory rate limiting (up to 60 embedding requests and 10 summaries per minute), and the hosting platform may keep ordinary request logs. Hugging Face, and any inference provider it routes the request to, process the text under their own policies. If you self-host or point AI calls to a third party, their policies will govern the transmitted data.

controls.title: Your controls
controls.description: You decide when and how your information is retained.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.description: Mnemos is designed for adult productivity use and is not intended for children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe a child has provided data, you can clear the browser storage or reach out for help below.
